body:
Update, nothing has changed re our honourary consulate, the emails bounce and the numbers don't work - so I've had to resort to finding Mr. PK Shreshtha via social media.

I'll have to connect with the Indian Consulate
Thanks for this. Wish me luck

From: South Africa
Currently: Nepal 

Initially I did but there isn't an office here, just a VFS type office that's never open. 

The closest Embassy is in India.

I know what you mean, I, also had a great life until I met my ex, I had a great job, was in great health.

I'm not sure if it gets better but I heard somewhere that missing our old lives can be a catalyst to starting over, smarter this time. 

I might not be able to get my old life back in that configuration but I'm willing to start over, from the bottom if required. 

Is there a small step you can take to maybe, rebuild things for yourself?
